definitions.explanation: A pungent bulb used as a flavoring in cooking.

examples.japanese: {大蒜|にんにく}を{みじん切|ぎ}りにする。
{大蒜|にんにく}の{匂|にお}いが{強|つよ}い。
ラーメンに{大蒜|にんにく}を{入|い}れて{食|た}べる。

notes:
{大蒜|にんにく} is a popular flavoring ingredient used in many cuisines.

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- {大蒜|にんにく}のみじん{切|ぎ}り: minced garlic
- おろし{大蒜|にんにく}: grated garlic
- {大蒜|にんにく}チップ: garlic chips

KANJI NOTE: Often written in hiragana (にんにく) or katakana (ニンニク). The kanji {大蒜|にんにく} is less commonly used.

HEALTH: Believed to have various health benefits, including boosting immunity.
